'''Matri Bey''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Trans-Nebular sector/Legends|Trans-Nebular sector]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the start of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. While a capable [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrat]] around [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], she was unable to stop the [[Corellian/Aqualish war|war]] between the [[Barralenal]] and the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] colonist group which led to her [[Death/Legends|death]].
